capabilities: Edit notes directly inside the hover popover
Open multiple popovers at the same time
Set the default editor mode for popovers
Auto-scroll to header or block ref locations
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian APIs, so future updates may break the plugin; beta testing is available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances the core "Page Preview" plugin by turning the hover popover into a full featured editor instance.
motivation: The author wants this functionality either built into Obsidian core or provided by an official popovers API.
problem: Obsidian's hover preview only shows a read-only page preview; users can't edit or interact with notes in the popover.

relations.evidence: This plugin enhances the core "Page Preview" plugin by turning the hover popover into a full featured editor instance.

summary: Turns the core Page Preview hover popover into a fully working, draggable editor instance.
